agent.problem: Most of the choices are luck-based discovery questions rather than informed guesses. For example, cards 8, 10, 11, 12 and 14 ask for the lampstand material, loaf count, row arrangement, frankincense and timing of the bread without earlier cards giving a basis to reason them out. Cards 2, 3 and 7 have the same problem, so discovery questions make up most of the stop rather than just a few.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
